utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning, all. Can everyone hear me? Teams reckons half of you are still joining.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, we're here. It's just thinking about it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Before we start, whose new car is that in the car park? Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Someone's new car in the car park and you've already clocked it. Nothing gets past you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It's taking up enough room to count as a small department.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one held together by road dirt.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I parked beside it. Felt like I ought to apologise to it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: For your parking or your car?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Both, probably.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, excellent. Vehicle assessment complete. Let's do the factory.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep. Morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just a completed one from me: signed off the inspection on the GT1 Compressor Section on Tuesday. That's all sorted.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. Nothing outstanding on that inspection, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, signed off and finished.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Pricey, the near miss at the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock needs writing up.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll write up the near miss at the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thanks, Pricey. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. That takes priority; by Thursday for the write-up.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out just after 'near miss' for me.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock. The near-miss write-up.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Got you. Audio's back.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Lovely. Whitty, over to your side.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Can you investigate the pressure drop on the GT2 water valve? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that. Investigate the pressure drop on the GT2 water valve.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Pressure drop, yeah. Rather than assuming the valve itself is the culprit.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. Investigation first, not jumping straight to swapping bits.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's it, Whitty. Worth understanding, but not an urgent call-out.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, go on—you were about to say something else.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I was, yeah. I'll run a function test on the 11kV board as well. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay, Whitty. Function test on the 11kV board, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Function test, not changing anything?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, just the function test. Nothing about altering settings.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay. Stores Jamie, what have you got?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll swap the filter on the line one HPU today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Two o'clock today, did you say?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, today at 2pm. The filter on the line one HPU.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thanks, stores Jamie. That's yours.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep. Not just me talking about a filter, I'm actually doing that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: We believed you. Mostly.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the gas valve on one on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cal, that one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Absolutely. Safety-critical priority straight away; on Friday is when the permit to work and isolation are required.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, Friday's the required date. I thought I'd missed a change there.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No change. I'll own the permit to work and isolation for the gas valve on one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, thanks, Cal.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Marc? Think you were trying to come in.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, so I'll do a site visit at the water works with the contractor after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, Marc. That's an 'if you've got a spare minute' one, not a rush.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. I'll take that after lunch, low-key rather than dropping everything.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I heard 'after lunch' about three times then. Someone's echoing.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Only said it once that time. I'm not that keen on lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You absolutely are.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. Anything unclear in what we've agreed?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, all clear here.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Same here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good stuff. Thanks, everyone. I'll let you get away.
